official_definition: Once per turn, you can send a core from your Spirit/Life to this Spirit. When you've done so, send up to three cores, besides 20px, from your Trash to your "Crimson".

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Crimson Awaken] or [Crimson Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Crimson Awaken]", "give [Crimson Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
